# What the server does with no scheduler flag. Do not edit by hand: regenerate on
# purpose (see tests/server/gpu_path_pin.rs) and justify each changed line.

== flags ==
--agent-hello-burst default=60 required=false
--agent-hello-interval default=1s required=false
--agent-pool-config default=none required=false
--agent-token-file default=none required=false
--boot default=none required=false values=initialise|resume
--config default=none required=false
--default-ttl default=600s required=false
--drain-timeout default=10s required=false
--handshake-timeout default=10s required=false
--header-timeout default=10s required=false
--listen default=127.0.0.1:7300 required=false
--max-connections default=256 required=false
--max-requests default=100 required=false
--max-ttl default=3600s required=false
--pool-config default=none required=false
--profile-store-bytes default=268435456 required=false
--read-timeout default=30s required=false
--require-host-credential default=none required=false values=true|false
--state-file default=none required=false
--tick default=5s required=false
--tls-cert default=none required=false
--tls-key default=none required=false
--token-file default=none required=false
--usage-db default=none required=false
--usage-off default=none required=false values=true|false
--write-timeout default=10s required=false

== state-files ==
without agent flags
  before start: pool.toml state/ token
  after start: pool.toml state/ state/leases.toml state/leases.toml.lock token
  after acquire: pool.toml state/ state/leases.toml state/leases.toml.lock token
  after shutdown: pool.toml state/ state/leases.toml state/leases.toml.lock token
with agent flags
  before start: agent-pool.toml agent-tokens pool.toml state/ token
  after start: agent-pool.toml agent-tokens pool.toml state/ state/leases.toml state/leases.toml.lock state/usage.db state/usage.db-shm state/usage.db-wal state/usage.db.lock token
  after acquire: agent-pool.toml agent-tokens pool.toml state/ state/leases.toml state/leases.toml.lock state/usage.db state/usage.db-shm state/usage.db-wal state/usage.db.lock token
  after an agent joins: agent-pool.toml agent-tokens pool.toml state/ state/leases.toml state/leases.toml.agents state/leases.toml.lock state/usage.db state/usage.db-shm state/usage.db-wal state/usage.db.lock token
  after shutdown: agent-pool.toml agent-tokens pool.toml state/ state/leases.toml state/leases.toml.agents state/leases.toml.lock state/usage.db state/usage.db.lock token
